convertibility_reason: Uses custom signal filter class CMS_ES_CCI from external .mqh library (Expert\Signal\MySignals\ACMS_ES_CCI.mqh). Trading logic is encapsulated in the custom signal class, not directly in the EA. The CExpert framework abstracts entry/exit logic into the signal object which must be manually inspected and translated.

other_exits: Signal-based close when signal strength falls below Signal_ThresholdClose (20), managed by CExpertSignal framework

position_sizing.conditional_logic: CMoneyFixedLot uses fixed lot size (0.1 lots); Percent parameter (10.0) may serve as risk fraction for lot validation but sizing is fixed-lot based

custom_logic_notes: Trading logic is fully encapsulated in the CMS_ES_CCI custom signal filter class (ACMS_ES_CCI.mqh). The EA uses MQL5's standard CExpert/CExpertSignal framework. Signal threshold mechanism: open threshold=40 (0-100 scale), close threshold=20. The CMS_ES_CCI filter combines CCI(25) with an MA(5) smoothing and generates a weighted signal (weight=1.0). Exact entry/exit conditions (crossover levels, overbought/oversold thresholds) require inspecting the ACMS_ES_CCI.mqh source. Expert_EveryTick=false means the EA evaluates on new bar close, not every tick. Pending order expiration is 4 bars.
python_conversion_notes: Must extract the CMS_ES_CCI signal logic from ACMS_ES_CCI.mqh before Python conversion is possible. The CExpert framework handles position management, signal aggregation, and order execution — all of which must be reimplemented. CCI is available in Python (ta-lib, pandas-ta) but the MA-smoothed CCI signal logic is custom. The threshold-based open/close mechanism (40/20) must be preserved. No SL/TP means exits are purely signal-driven. The EveryTick=false flag simplifies conversion to a bar-close evaluation model. Pending order expiration (4 bars) is unused if orders are market execution type.
